mei_eval: quick note — saw a reproducible 'ellipsis join' during compact-int6 bringup on mixed CJK+RTL strings. zh/ja->en BLEU down ~1.7 vs fp16 on loc-ellipsis-1k. example below.

yuki_onboard: paste config + sample pls

mei_eval: run id 2026-08-07-ellipsis-int6, model: compact-lite v1, quant=int6 per-channel, kernels=auto, tokenizer v2026-07-20. eval: loc-ellipsis-1k. sample:
```
input: "\u65e5\u672c\u3001\u2026 \u0627\u0644\u0628\u0631\u0646\u0627\u0645\u062c"  // CJK + IDEOGRAPHIC COMMA + HORIZONTAL ELLIPSIS + Arabic
fp16: "Japan, ... the program"
int6: "Japan,...the program"
// note: removed space after ellipsis -> fused token boundary
```

sam_kernel: hmm looks like spacing after multi-dot sequence collapsed. tokenizer roundtrip ok?

mei_eval: roundtrip OK, token ids identical. issue only in generation. reproduced on GPU and CPU. tried forcing RT_KV_FP16=true and RT_ACCUM_FP16=true — that recovers BLEU to -0.2 and fixes sample spacing (latency +8-12ms).

eva_research: that suggests numeric drift in kv/accum path affects short-run punctuation tokens. can you capture per-token logits + kv dumps for int6 vs fp16? attach to ticket.

ops_john: for Dedicated/Private customers recommend a temporary Optimize suggestion: "kv_fp16=true" for datasets with CJK adjacent to punctuation/ellipsis. add opt-out.

mei_eval: opened issue https://redwood.internal/issue/ELLIP-INT6-77 with artifacts and a minimal fuzz test that inserts ellipses next to CJK/RTL boundaries. CI paused int6 canary for loc-ellipsis slice.

ci-bot: kicked off CI run ELLIP-INT6-77 (#4582) on eng-ml/compact-lite-int6 builders x3.

eva_research: follow-ups: try int6 with FP16 accumulation only vs FP16 kv only to isolate which path dominates; try soft-split inserting ZWSP after ellipsis as a temporary mitigant.

mei_eval: doing that now, will update the ticket with dumps + small PR for fuzz cases. :thumbsup:
